sentences.en: My dear little cat has been missing for a week.
sentences.zh: 我亲爱的猫咪已经失踪了一个星期。

sentences.en: My mother has sold everything that is dear to her.
sentences.zh: 我母亲把她珍视的一切都卖掉了。

sentences.en: Dear woman, why do you involve me? Jesus replied.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的女人，你为什么要牵扯到我？耶稣回答说。

senses.zh: 严重的，珍贵的，亲爱的，昂贵的，衷心的
